reviewDoc:
Step 3 (question bank + rubric) is APPROVED. All four verification commands were independently re-run in the worktree and pass:
- backend `npm test`: 104 unit tests pass, 0 fail (74 baseline + 30 new).
- backend `npm run test:e2e`: 78 passed, 7 skipped (the two Postgres suites migrations.e2e/jobQueue.e2e self-skip offline), 0 fail.
- frontend `npm run lint`: exit 0, warnings only (no errors). The two react(set-state-in-effect) warnings on Questions.jsx:64 and Rubrics.jsx:43 match the existing load()-in-useEffect convention in admin/Users.jsx and admin/Subjects.jsx.
- frontend `npm run build`: exit 0, 2324 modules transformed, built successfully.

Acceptance criteria verified against the code (diff reviewed main...HEAD, two commits):
1. New question fields + lifecycle: src/domain/questionStatus.js is a pure state machine with the exact transition map; approve asserts transition to APPROVED and requires rubric_id (409 RUBRIC_REQUIRED); reject requires a trimmed reason (400 REASON_REQUIRED) and stores review_note; archive asserts transition; illegal moves throw 409 INVALID_TRANSITION. isExamEligible returns true only for APPROVED.
2. Filters: questionRepository.findAllFiltered({status,bloom,source}) applied in the app layer so it works against Postgres and the in-memory mock; list controller reads req.query.
3. Excel import: questionService.importQuestions validates the whole file first and returns {ok:false, errors:[{row, errors[]}]} with ZERO writes on any error, else inserts every row with source='IMPORT' status='APPROVED'; buildImportTemplate() yields the 7 headers (verified by unit test). Mirrors adminService.importStudents.
4. Downloadable template: GET /questions/template streams the xlsx; frontend downloadTemplate() does its own fetch to read the blob.
5. Mock embedding adapter with clean DI seam: createEmbeddingAdapter(env) defaults to the deterministic L2-normalized 1024-dim mock (mock/unset), falls back to mock on unknown provider; wired in app.js via overrides.embeddingAdapter seam so Step 4 can add a Titan provider.
6. Near-duplicate: non-blocking NEAR_DUPLICATE warning when cosine >= 0.9 against same-subject questions (scan via findSubjectEmbeddingsByTopic), question still saved; exact-duplicate normalized content stays a hard 409 DUPLICATE_QUESTION checked BEFORE the embedding scan.
7. Rubric CRUD + lock + clone: updateRubric blocked with 409 RUBRIC_LOCKED when is_locked; cloneRubric copies criteria + performance_levels and bumps version with is_locked=false; performance-level validation (label required, numeric min<=max, integer order). Covered by unit + e2e tests.
8. LECTURER guards: /questions and /rubrics routers gate all writes/lifecycle/import behind requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER'); reads require requireAuth. e2e asserts 401/403.
9. Migration 012_question_embedding_index.sql adds only the HNSW cosine index on question.embedding; diff confirms migrations 001-011 are unchanged (empty diff).
10. Postgres e2e self-skips offline (7 skipped) so the suite stays green without Docker.
11. Frontend wired to real endpoints: the Step-3 worktree Questions.jsx/Rubrics.jsx import from questionApi.js/rubricApi.js and no longer call /api/lecturer/*; new fields, status/Bloom/source filters, per-row import error table, approve/reject/archive actions, rubric performance-levels + lock + clone are present; the 'Generate with AI' control is rendered DISABLED with no generation logic.

Scope guard respected: no RAG/AI generation, exams, interview, or scoring was added. Verdict: APPROVED.
